connect.title: Connect to an Ahab server
connect.lead: The address you open Ahab at, such as https://ahab.example or http://192.168.1.20:8180.

pairing.title: Pair with {{host}}
pairing.notPairingLink: This is not a pairing link.

join.title: Add this computer as a machine of {{name}}?
join.lead: Agents can then work in folders on this computer. Ahab's daemon runs here in the background, as your user, connected to that server; its approval shows on the server as any machine's does.
join.runsServer: This computer is set up to run its own Ahab server. After joining, only its daemon runs here, connected to {{name}}; the server here stops, and its data stays where it is.

pair.title: Pair this app with a server?
pair.lead: A link asks to pair this app with:
pair.warning: Pair only with a server you know: it is shown in this window and can send you notifications.

join.title: Add this computer as a machine?
join.lead: A link asks to join this computer to a server, so its agents can work in folders here:
join.fingerprint: Server key {{fingerprint}}; joining fails if the server shows another.
join.noFingerprint: The link does not say the server's key fingerprint, so this computer trusts the key the server shows.

unknown.title: This app is not paired with that server

unpaired.title: {{name}} no longer knows this app
unpaired.lead: This app was revoked there as a client, or the server was set up again. Pair again to use it.

unreachable.title: {{name}} does not answer
unreachable.stopped: Ahab is stopped on this computer.

failed.existing: Ahab on this computer does not answer

running.title: Setting up Ahab
running.connecting: Connecting to Ahab on this computer
running.machine: This computer is ready for agents

servers.title: Servers
servers.leadKeychain: Each is paired with this app, with its own credential in the system keychain.
servers.leadEncryptedFile: Each is paired with this app, with its own credential (in an encrypted file: no keychain answered).
servers.none: This app is not paired with a server yet.
servers.name: Name

remove.question: Remove {{name}}?
remove.detail: This app is revoked there as a client when it answers, and its credential is forgotten here. Nothing on the server is deleted.

role.stopped: Ahab is set up here but stopped.
role.none: Neither runs Ahab nor is a machine of a server.

computer.heading: This computer
computer.managed: Your system configuration (such as Home Manager) runs Ahab here: start and stop it there.

stop.question: Stop Ahab on this computer?
stop.question_daemon: Stop this computer's daemon on this computer?
stop.detail: Agents and terminals on this computer stop, and it no longer starts when you log in. Nothing is deleted; start it again here or with `ahab up`.
stop.action_daemon: Stop this computer's daemon on this computer

start.action_daemon: Start this computer's daemon on this computer

leave.question: Leave {{server}}?
leave.detail: This computer's daemon stops, and agents can no longer work here. Its key stays; remove the machine on the server under Settings → Machines.

app.heading: The app

tray.title: Keep in the tray when the last window closes
tray.detail: Quitting never stops Ahab's service. By default on when Ahab runs on this computer.
tray.label: Keep in the tray

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.detail: Native notifications for what Ahab tells you while its window is in the background.

shortcut.label: Global shortcut to bring Ahab forward

app.keychain: Credentials are kept in the system keychain.
app.encryptedFile: Credentials are kept in an encrypted file in the app's data folder.

welcome.title: Your agents, on your machines.
welcome.lead: Ahab runs the coding agents you already use, in folders on this computer and on every machine you add.
welcome.noAhab: This app has no Ahab to run on this computer.
welcome.noServiceManager: This computer has no service manager to keep Ahab running in the background.
welcome.haveServer: I already have an Ahab server →

phone.lead: Connect this phone to your Ahab server, and follow your agents from anywhere.
